newsitem.title: ISRAEL: PLO arrests Islamic Jihad men planning attack.
newsitem.headline: PLO arrests Islamic Jihad men planning attack.

text.p: Palestinian security forces have arrested four Islamic Jihad men who planned to attack Israelis, a senior Palestinian security source said on Friday.

"We arrested three days ago a group of people from the Islamic Jihad who were preparing for a military operation against Israeli targets. We arrested four people, one of them tried to escape. We shot him in the leg and we captured him."
He said the group was arrested in the Bethlehem West Bank Palestinian self-rule enclave.

The source denied an Israel Channel Two Television report that the nature of the attack the four were planning was a suicide bombing but he did not elaborate. He also denied the television's report that some 80 Islamic Jihad supporters were arrested after the first group was caught.
Islamic Jihad and the larger Hamas Islamic Resistance Movement have led opposition to peace deals between Israel and the Palestine Liberation Organisation by attacking Israelis.
In a wave of suicide attacks in February and March three Hamas bombers and one Islamic Jihad man killed 59 people.
